status_meanings.compiled_rom_logic: Original controller code is present in the compiled reference prototype; this is independent of the hand-written simulator.
status_meanings.sampled_cpu_cuda: The listed actors or states occur in exactly matched persistent CPU/CUDA replays. This is bounded evidence, not complete interaction qualification.
status_meanings.context_cpu_cuda: Relevant contexts occur in matching replays; feature-specific interactions still need targeted assertions.
status_meanings.needs_targeted_clips: Compiled logic exists, but this feature needs targeted clip coverage.
